answer_1.quote: The fill-in-the-blanks setting requires the prediction of context‑aware antonyms by capturing the contrasting features between the word pair.

answer_2.quote: We used top‑1 and top‑10 accuracy values as the measures for the correctness of model predictions.

answer_4.quote: To assess the difficulty of this task, we asked three human subjects to guess at most five possible words to fill the blanks in the test set... For this analysis, we used 100 instances... Table reports the number of predictions from the human subjects and the proposed method for which the manual evaluation recognized contrastiveness and naturalness (fluency).
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators provided up to five candidate words for each blank and judged whether the filled sentence was appropriate, focusing on contrastiveness (as an antonym) and naturalness (fluency).
